description: Free: works without an API key or Pro plan (the hosted server only needs a signed-in account). Looks up a term in the Signal8 Academy glossary (signal8.ai/learn/glossary): dilution, SEC filing and trading jargon such as "ATM offering", "baby shelf", "full ratchet", "pre-funded warrant", "going concern", "LULD", "days to cover", "Form 25". Accepts a glossary slug ("atm-offering"), the term itself, or a common alias ("ATM", "price reset"); matching is case- and punctuation-insensitive. Returns the term, a one-line short definition, the long definition as Markdown, related terms, the Academy guides that use it, and the public url. A TERM_NOT_FOUND error means the glossary has no entry for that wording, not that the concept does not exist; the Academy guide search may still cover it.

term.description: Term, alias or glossary slug, e.g. "baby shelf", "ATM", "full-ratchet".

name: define_term
title: Define a Market / SEC Term
